speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have presented with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as diarrhea or constipation, or any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any shortness of breath, chronic cough, or chest pain? I also need to know if you have a history of smoking or any recent travel to areas with high tuberculosis prevalence.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: This fixed, painless supraclavicular lymph node is highly concerning for malignancy, likely metastatic cancer from the abdomen or chest. DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic Adenocarcinoma
